artifacts.notes: Complete downloaded Miscellanea Agostiniana volume I (1930), 868 PDF pages and 60232408 bytes, including title pages, Morin’s edition and apparatus; title page PDF p. 7 and target text PDF pp. 228–231 visually inspected. This is volume I, not the multi-volume series. The 1930 printing entered the United States public domain on 2026-01-01. Its introductory/editorial material is distinguished from Augustine’s sermons.
artifacts.rights_basis: The identified 1930 printing is public domain in the United States by publication date. The exact artifact is a mechanical facsimile or uncorrected OCR of that printing; digitizer identification adds factual provenance, not a new edition of the work.
